facts.fact: ONECI's director-general says the national identity card has been digitalised through the MyONECI+ app.

CIV.note: No exchange between civil register and ID stated.
Only a general call to use ONECI's digital civil-status website; no register status stated.
No data centre for hire named.
A decree is mentioned only in passing; no law or its standing stated.
Only a count of nearly 10 million NNIs, with no population share.

facts.fact: ONECI's director-general says it is working to give newborns an NNI in maternities.

CIV.note: Who runs or owns the platform is not stated.

facts.fact: ONECI's director-general says administrative procedures must go through the NNI under a decree, and that taxpayer, social security and CMU numbers should soon be linked to it.
ONECI's director-general says nearly 10 million people have been given an NNI, a unique random number tied to civil identity and biometrics, within the RNPP.

CIV.note: No data centre for hire named.

facts.fact: ONECI's director-general says the Registre national des personnes physiques, built on the NNI, is a reality and its data can be released to bodies with ARTCI's signed approval.

CIV.note: No local-office digital entry of births or deaths stated.
Only a hoped-for link of taxpayer account to NNI; no tax register status.
